purpose: Correct the V75 scalar-composite masking defect without changing the exact truth-label randomization null. Audit separate rank and coverage conditional p-values under a six-test family-wise correction, independently verify power with frozen synthetic alternatives, and stop before a complete prospective gate or new candidate.

scientific_rule.retained_null: Use the V75 field-level exact truth-label randomization unchanged, including priorities that move with fields for ties.
metrics: maximum absolute deviation of empirical 68/95-percent coverage from its field-label conditional null
scientific_rule.conditional_p_value: For each metric separately, (1 + number of random relabelings with the metric at least the observed metric)/(1 + random relabelings).
scientific_rule.multiplicity: Bonferroni over three domains times two separately necessary calibration metrics; this controls family-wise type-I error without an independence assumption.
scientific_rule.domain_pass: both rank and coverage p-values pass
scientific_rule.nonmasking_invariant: The rule fails whenever either metric p-value in any domain is at or below 1/120, regardless of the other metric's value.
scientific_rule.claim_boundary: Passing means neither frozen metric detects conditional field nonexchangeability at family-wise alpha 0.05. It is not proof that the generator is correct or that the test has power against every alternative.

existing_null_calibration_audit.input: Only the calibration and verification rank_tv and coverage_deviation arrays already written by V75; no synthetic field regeneration.
existing_null_calibration_audit.tail_convention: inclusive upper tail with add-one finite-Monte-Carlo correction
reports: per-scenario and per-metric rejection probability with Wilson 95-percent interval
the mathematical Bonferroni family-wise upper bound of 0.05
existing_null_calibration_audit.individual_calibrated_if: Every per-scenario per-metric point rejection probability is <=0.01 and every Wilson 95-percent upper bound is <=0.011.
existing_null_calibration_audit.family_diagnostic_calibrated_if: Every per-scenario three-domain extrapolated rejection probability is <=0.055.

deterministic_nonmasking_audit.test: Enumerate every ordered rank/coverage pair. The implemented pass decision must equal (rank_p > 1/120 and coverage_p > 1/120). Explicit rank-only and coverage-only failures must be detected.

independent_synthetic_power_audit.common_structure: 0.7 field-global normal plus sqrt(1-0.7^2) iid voxel normal

alternatives.location_bias: sixteen generated fields have conditional mean +0.5 while truth fields have mean zero
alternatives.underdispersion: sixteen generated fields have conditional standard deviation 0.6 while truth fields have standard deviation one

independent_synthetic_power_audit.detection: rank conditional p-value <=1/120 or coverage conditional p-value <=1/120
reports: rank, coverage, and union detection probability per alternative
independent_synthetic_power_audit.power_sufficient_if: Both alternatives have union point detection probability >=0.8 and Wilson 95-percent lower bound >=0.7.

consumed_V75_diagnostic.input: Only consumed_V72_diagnostic values embedded in the immutable V75 audit result; do not reopen any V72 ensemble or array.
consumed_V75_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; cannot select, validate, rescue, or change the V72 verdict
consumed_V75_diagnostic.report: Apply the proposed separate per-test threshold to the already reported candidate and control p-values and identify scalar-composite masking cases.

select_separate_rule_if_all: all existing-null individual calibration requirements pass
all existing-null family diagnostic requirements pass
both independent synthetic power requirements pass
decision_rules.if_selected_next: Freeze a complete prospective 32-query gate combining V74 physical, morphology, and energy rules with the V76 separate exact-label rule, then await explicit approval before constructing or evaluating a new candidate.
decision_rules.if_failed_next: Stop before a complete gate or new candidate and report which frozen requirement failed.

scope_limits.new_random_data: only the frozen independent synthetic power alternatives

execution.cpu_policy: one process pinned to logical CPU 64 at nice 15
